cat >> journal.md << 'EOF'

## [2026-06-10 23:30] — paper experiments built: deepthin, procedural warmup, output embedding centering

**TL;DR:** Implemented three paper-based experiments from research.md plus before/after-SLERP placement variants, all driven by new exp.py: MobileLLM deep-and-thin (arXiv 2402.14905, dim 64 / 19 unique layers / 1,039,488 params), Procedural Pretraining (arXiv 2601.21725, 5M-token Dyck warm-up = 0.25% of budget), Output Embedding Centering (arXiv 2601.02031, mu-centering of the tied embedding after every optimizer step). Baseline 2B@10% run launched, then a queued sequence of 5 experiment pipelines. Committed 8ff1e69 plus a pyaot tuple-concat false-positive fix.

**Long description:** User task: pick papers (not ideas) from research.md, test against a fresh 2B-token 10%-quality baseline, and test technique placement before vs after the first SLERP like the STM experiments. Hourglass FFN (2602.06471) was considered and dropped — the paper text retrieved did not specify shapes precisely enough to implement faithfully. New pieces: src/mythosmini/data/procedural.py (generate_dyck_sequence over ()[]{}<> with depth bound; build_procedural_cache writing EOS-separated uint16 caches, deterministic per seed); TrainConfig.center_output_embeddings (default False = no behavior change) consumed in run_training via new center_output_embedding(model) after optimizer.step; exp.py with variants deepthin/proc/oec (full pretrain + 3-round STM + slerp, same shape as train.py) and proc_after/oec_after (copy base checkpoints, save champion as step_00009000.pt, continue training it — proc_after 5M Dyck tokens, oec_after one 64M fineweb pass with centering, both constant lr 3e-4 — then slerp). Deep-thin config chosen by param sweep to match the 1,047,168 baseline within 0.8%. Proving tests written first: 5 procedural tests (balancedness, token alphabet, exact cache size, determinism, bad-size rejection), centering zero-mean test. Queue: /tmp/run_experiments.sh waits for the baseline run then runs the five exp.py pipelines sequentially; logs in /tmp/r0_baseline.log .. /tmp/r5_oec_after.log.

**What worked:** 16 new tests pass; make lint exit 0; make pyaot clean after fixing a real pyaot false positive (tuple+tuple concatenation now infers TupleType(left.elems+right.elems) instead of E0006). Ruff caught two real B023 loop-variable-capture bugs in run_stm_from_checkpoint's on_epoch closure — fixed with default-arg binding.

**What failed:** tests/e2e/test_train_entry.py::test_full_pipeline_end_to_end and once tests/test_stm.py::test_run_stm_from_checkpoint_saves_round_checkpoints failed with CUDA OOM ("Tried to allocate 64.00 MiB ... Process 368694 has 26.19 GiB in use") — transient, caused by the concurrent baseline training run saturating the GPU, same failure mode recorded 2026-06-10 12:10. Re-run after the experiment queue drains.

**What was kept / discarded:** Kept everything described. Discarded the hourglass-FFN candidate (insufficient spec; recorded so it is not retried blind).

**Open questions / next steps:** When the queue finishes: extract per-variant best-before-slerp and champion scores, build the comparison table, scores.md rows per variant, full test suite re-run to clear the OOM failures, prune docs if needed.
